lines.hello: When you're ready, hand up, palm to me.
lines.open: Open your hand wide, and hold it.
lines.fist: Well done. Now a fist, thumb outside.
lines.fist-skip: Let's move on. A fist, thumb outside.
lines.reps-10: Well done. Open and close, ten times, slowly.
lines.reps-10-skip: Let's move on. Open and close, ten times.
lines.grip-phone: Well done. Now pick up your phone.
lines.grip-phone-skip: Let's move on. Pick up your phone.
lines.done-skip: Let's leave it there. Well done today.
lines.stopped: Okay, we'll stop here. Well done today.
lines.fix-sideways: Turn your palm to face me.
lines.nudge-hello: Take your time. Hand up, palm to me.
lines.nudge-open: Take your time. Open your hand wide.
lines.nudge-fist: Take your time. A fist, thumb outside.
lines.nudge-reps: Take your time. Open, then close.
lines.nudge-grip-phone: Take your time. Pick up your phone.
lines.paused: Okay. Rest. Say ready to go on.
lines.pain: Let's stop and rest. If it keeps hurting, tell your therapist.
lines.camera-off: Camera is off. Tell me how it feels.
lines.v-noise: Saved. Inside your usual range today.
lines.v-tighter: Saved. Your fist closed further than usual.
lines.v-looser: Saved. Your fist was looser than usual.
lines.v-building: Saved. A few more checks build your range.
